rows.title: Combined Taraxacum mongolicum and Astragalus polysaccharides attenuate CCl(4)-induced hepatic fibrosis through modulation of the TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB signaling pathway and gut microbiota composition.
rows.evidence_boundary: The findings are from a CCl4-induced mouse fibrosis model; they support mechanistic and gut-liver-axis hypotheses but do not establish human efficacy, dosing, or safety.

rows.title: Efficacy and safety of cannabinoid-based interventions for behavioral and cognitive symptoms in dementia: systematic review and meta-analysis.
rows.evidence_boundary: The synthesis is limited by a small and heterogeneous cannabinoid trial base in dementia; formulation, dose, outcome, and population differences limit product-level conclusions.

rows.title: Efficacy and Safety of Cannabinoid-Based Interventions for Low Back Pain and Migraine: A Systematic Review of Randomized Controlled Trials.
rows.evidence_boundary: Evidence is indication- and formulation-specific across isolated, synthetic, vaporized, and extract cannabinoid interventions; the review does not support broad class-level efficacy claims.

rows.title: Pharmacological treatments of REM sleep behaviour disorder in synucleinopathies: a systematic review of effectiveness and safety.
rows.evidence_boundary: This review concerns pharmacological management of RBD in synucleinopathies, not general sleep supplementation; study designs and disease populations are heterogeneous.

rows.title: Does co-administration of cannabidiol (CBD) influence the plasma availability of delta-9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) and its active metabolite in humans? A systematic review and meta-analysis.
rows.evidence_boundary: Acute human pharmacokinetic evidence concerns matched THC with and without CBD; results should not be generalized to chronic use, other ratios, routes, or CBD-only products.
